gbm_population_evidence.quote: Glioblastoma (GBM); Diffuse Midline Glioma (DMG); Astrocytoma, IDH-Mutant, Grade 4; Diffuse Hemispheric Glioma, H3 G34-Mutant; Gliosarcoma of Brain
Eligible diagnoses include: Glioblastoma (IDH-wildtype), Gliosarcoma, Diffuse Midline Glioma (H3 K27-altered)

candidate_evidence.quote: assessing the safety and efficacy of concurrent intrathecal azacitidine and intrathecal nivolumab in recurrent high-grade glioma

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Documented recurrence by diagnostic biopsy or contrast-enhanced magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) per RANO 2.0 criteria

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: To assess biomarkers for immunologic and epigenetic effects of therapy: Changes in CSF and blood immunological profiling by flow cytometry, cytokine/chemokine analysis.

role_evidence.quote: Intrathecal nivolumab will be given at a flat dose of 40 mg
Intrathecal azacitidine will be dose-escalated with 4 dose levels (5, 10, 20, 40 mg) using a 3+3 design.

agents.drug_class_hint: hypomethylating nucleoside analogue (DNMT inhibitor), given intrathecally

biomarkers.biomarker_other: circulating tumour DNA in CSF (quantification, DNA methylation)

source_quote.quote: Changes in circulating tumor DNA (ctDNA) analysis in CSF

coder_notes: Mixed high-grade glioma population (GBM, gliosarcoma, DMG, H3 G34, IDH-mutant grade 4); also enrols ages 13-17 (mixed_age is set by script). IDH/H3 status appear only as diagnostic categories of eligible diagnoses, not as entry biomarkers, so not listed. Both intrathecal agents are investigational (new route) and are coded experimental_combination.
